subject: Trial extension request
body:
Hi,

We started our 14-day trial last week, but the timing turned out to be bad: half of our team was at a conference for five days and our project lead was out sick for another three. In practice we've only had about four real days to evaluate the product, and we haven't even had a chance to test the client portal, which is the main reason we're considering switching from our current tool.

Would it be possible to extend the trial by another two weeks? We have a decision meeting scheduled for the 24th and I'd like to go into it with a proper recommendation rather than a guess. If it helps, we're looking at roughly 25 seats on the Business plan.

Our workspace is harrowgate-consulting.ourapp.com.

Thanks very much,
Priyanka Desai
Head of Delivery, Harrowgate Consulting
trial ended but i was on holiday for most of it. can i get another week?

subject: What happens when trial ends
body: What happens to our data when the trial ends if we don't pay right away? We're waiting on budget sign-off, which could take a couple of weeks after the trial expires. I don't want our team to lose the boards we've spent two weeks setting up. Will it all still be there when we subscribe?

subject: Trial ended early?
body: My trial was supposed to last 14 days. I signed up on the 3rd and today (the 10th) it says my trial has expired and I need to choose a plan. That's only 7 days. Did I misunderstand something? Email: rafael.monteiro@outlook.com.br

Hello, can the trial be extended to 30 days? We are a government agency and our procurement process takes at least 3 weeks before we can buy anything. We are very interested but we need more time to evaluate properly. Thank you.

subject: Trial for Business features
body: We're on the Pro plan already and want to try the Business features (SSO and advanced reporting) before upgrading. Is there a way to start a Business trial on our existing paid workspace without creating a new one? Workspace ID ws_48200.

subject: Please extend - IT approval pending
body: Our trial ends tomorrow. Everyone who's used it loves it, but our IT security team still hasn't finished reviewing your security documentation, and we can't sign up until they approve. They've said they need about another 10 days. Could you extend our trial until then? I'd hate for the team to lose momentum. Our workspace is cobalt-marine.ourapp.com and my email is j.fairweather@cobaltmarine.co.uk. I'm happy to jump on a call if that helps.
Trial expired this morning and now I can't even export the tasks I created. I'm not ready to pay yet but I need that data. Can you reopen the trial for a day so I can get it out?

subject: Second trial
body: We did a trial about a year ago but didn't go ahead because of budget. Things have changed and we'd like to evaluate again, especially since you've added a lot of features since then. Is it possible to do another trial on the same workspace?

subject: Trial users
body: Is there a limit on the number of users during the trial? We're trying to get our whole team of 45 to test it but invites stopped working after 20 people. We only have 5 days left on the trial so it's a bit urgent.
extend trial pls, we got stuck on setup. acct_tr99xk

subject: Trial ends but no card on file
body: My trial ends in 3 days. I didn't enter a card. Do I need to do anything to stop it, or will it just stop? I'm still deciding whether to keep using it.

subject: Button does nothing
body: The "Duplicate project" button in the project menu does nothing when I click it. No error, no new project appears. Tried on three different projects. Chrome 129 on Windows.

subject: Wrong totals in time report
body:
Hello support,

The time-tracking report is showing incorrect totals. For the week of the 9th, the report says our team logged 312 hours, but when I export the raw entries to CSV and add them up in Excel, the total is 287.5 hours. I checked a few individual people and it looks like entries that span midnight (we have some night-shift staff) are being counted twice, once on each day.

This matters for us because we bill clients based on this report. We've already sent two invoices using these numbers and now I have to go back and check them all.

Could you confirm whether this is a known issue and whether there's a fix coming? In the meantime, is there a setting to avoid double-counting?

Thanks,
Marcus Oyelaran
Finance, Tidewater Security Services
Workspace: tidewater-security.ourapp.com

When I drag a task from one column to another on the board, it jumps back to the original column after about a second. Only happens in the "Sprint 14" board, other boards are fine. Refreshing doesn't help. Error in the console says ERR_BOARD_SYNC_412.

subject: Due date off by one day
body: When I set a due date using the date picker, it saves as the day before. E.g. I pick the 20th, it shows the 19th. Started happening this week. I'm in New Zealand (UTC+13) if that's relevant.

subject: Comment formatting broken
body: Bullet points and bold in comments are no longer rendering. They show up as raw asterisks and dashes. This started after the update last night. It's not critical but everyone on our team has noticed.
The search bar returns zero results for anything I type, even task names I can see on screen right now. Tried exact titles. Everything else works.

subject: Recurring tasks creating duplicates
body: Our weekly recurring tasks are creating two copies every Monday instead of one. It started about three weeks ago. We now have dozens of duplicate tasks cluttering our board. I've tried deleting the recurrence and setting it up again, but the duplicates keep coming. We have about 15 recurring tasks, all of them do it. Our team is starting to ignore the board because of the clutter, which defeats the whole purpose. Workspace ID ws_65510.

subject: Can't upload attachments over 10MB
body: Your pricing page says Business allows 250MB attachments, but anything over 10MB fails with "Upload failed". We're on Business. Tried PDF and MP4 files.

The @mention autocomplete doesn't show anyone whose name has an accent (José, Zoë, Søren). Typing their name manually doesn't tag them either. Pretty embarrassing for our international team, to be honest.

subject: Gantt chart dependencies wrong
body: In the Gantt view, when I move a task, the dependent tasks don't move with it even though "auto-schedule dependents" is on. The arrows still show the dependency. This worked last month.

subject: Printing a board cuts off columns
body: When I print a board (or save as PDF from the print dialog), anything after the fourth column is cut off. There's no option to fit to page. Minor, but we print the board for our Monday stand-up.
Custom fields of type "currency" show $ even though I set the currency to EUR in the field settings. Values are correct, just the symbol is wrong.

subject: Automation not triggering
body: We have an automation: "When status changes to Done, move task to Archive project". It worked for months. Since last Thursday it doesn't trigger at all. The automation log shows no runs since then. We haven't changed anything. We have about 20 other automations and those seem fine. Workspace ID W-72031.

subject: Emoji in task title breaks sorting
body: If a task title starts with an emoji, alphabetical sort puts it in a random position instead of at the start or end. Small thing, but it drives our PM crazy.

Everything was fine until today's update. Now whenever I open a task that has more than about 50 comments, the page freezes and Chrome asks if I want to wait or kill the page. Tasks with fewer comments open normally. Unfortunately our most important tasks are the ones with lots of discussion.

subject: Filters reset after refresh
body: Saved filters on the list view reset to default every time I refresh the page. I click "Save view", it says saved, but after a reload all filters are gone. Happens for me and two colleagues.

subject: Dashboard widget shows 'NaN'
body: One of our dashboard widgets (average cycle time) now shows "NaN days" instead of a number. The other widgets on the same dashboard work fine. It showed 4.2 days last week.

Hi! When I undo (Ctrl+Z) after deleting a task, it restores the task but without its subtasks. The subtasks are just gone. I found them in trash but had to restore them one by one and re-link them. Is that expected?

subject: Site down?
body: Is the app down? I get "503 Service Unavailable" on every page. My coworkers in a different city get the same thing.

subject: OUTAGE - entire team blocked
body: Nothing loads for anyone in our company since about 8:15am Eastern. We get a blank page and then "Unable to connect". Our IT team confirmed it's not our network, other sites work fine. We have 200 people who can't work and a client deliverable at noon. Your status page shows all systems operational, which is clearly wrong. Please give us an update ASAP. Org ID 77120.
Nothing is saving. Every edit shows "Could not save changes, retrying..." and then reverts. Whole team is seeing it. Is something going on?

subject: API and web app both down
body: Our integration is getting connection timeouts from your API and the web app won't load either. Started around 14:20 UTC. This is blocking our production order processing. Is there an incident? We'll need an incident report afterwards for our own customers. Our account ID is acct_pr0d44.

subject: Can't access anything
body: Hello, since this morning none of our 12 users can open any project. The app loads but every project shows "Something went wrong". We've tried different browsers and devices. We have a board meeting this afternoon and all our materials are in there. Please let us know what's happening.
down again?? third time this month. our entire support team uses this for ticket tracking and we're dead in the water. how long this time

subject: EU region outage?
body: Our workspace is hosted in your EU region. Since 06:00 CET everything times out. A colleague with a US-hosted workspace says hers works fine. So I guess it's EU only? We're 80 people in Berlin sitting around. Please confirm and give an ETA. Workspace berlin-hq.ourapp.com

subject: Login and app both failing
body: None of us can log in. The login page loads but after entering credentials it spins then says "Server error, please try again". Tried with 5 different accounts on our team. Not a password issue, it's everyone. Is there an outage?
Is anyone else having problems? Our whole office (about 30 people) can't load boards since 10 minutes ago. Getting 500 errors. Twitter says others are too.

subject: Outage + SLA credit
body: We had a complete outage of about 4 hours yesterday. Our Enterprise contract includes a 99.9% uptime SLA. Could you confirm the outage window from your side and let us know how to claim the SLA credit? I'd also appreciate a root cause analysis for our compliance team. Org ID 20331.

subject: Mobile and web both down
body: Hi, our field team can't load anything on the iOS app, and the office staff can't load anything on the web either. Both show a connection error. We run our whole dispatch operation through your app so this is really bad. We have trucks waiting. Please call me or reply ASAP. Workspace: swiftline-couriers.ourapp.com

The entire app has been read-only for our company for the last hour. We can view everything but any edit fails with "Workspace is in maintenance mode". There was no maintenance announcement. We're 60 people trying to close out our month-end.

subject: Everything is slow
body: Every page takes 10-15 seconds to load today. Normally it's instant. It's not our internet, other sites are fast. Our whole team is affected. Everything does load eventually, it's just painfully slow.

subject: Board with 2000 tasks is very slow
body: Our main board has about 2,000 tasks. Opening it takes around 20 seconds and scrolling is jerky. Smaller boards are fast. Is there a recommended limit for board size? Or anything we can do to speed it up besides archiving? We need most of those tasks visible for our team's daily planning.
search takes forever (like 30s) to return results since last week. used to be instant. still works just slow

subject: API response times
body: We've been monitoring response times on your REST API. The p95 latency for GET /v2/tasks has gone from about 200ms to 2.5s over the past week. No errors, just much slower. This is making our sync jobs run 10x longer. Example request ID from a slow call: req_91ad7e03. Any changes on your side?

subject: App is laggy while typing
body: When I type in the task description field, there's a noticeable lag, like half a second between pressing a key and seeing the letter. Makes writing long descriptions really frustrating. Other text fields are fine. Chrome on a fairly new MacBook.

subject: Reports taking minutes to generate
body:
Hello,

Our monthly utilisation report used to generate in about 10 seconds. Over the past month it's gotten steadily slower, and today it took almost 4 minutes. Sometimes it times out with "Report generation failed, please try again", and then works on the second or third try.

We run this report every Monday morning for our leadership meeting, so the delays are becoming a real problem. We have around 150 users and three years of data. Is there something about the size of our account that's causing this? We'd be willing to archive old projects if that would help, but we'd like to understand the cause first.

Our org ID is 60215.

Thanks,
Dana Whitlock
PMO, Kellerman Engineering
Uploading files has become super slow for us - a 5MB PDF takes about a minute. Downloads are normal speed. We're on a 500 Mbps office connection. Started maybe 2 days ago.

subject: Slow during US mornings
body: Every day between about 9am and 11am Eastern the app gets really slow for us, pages take 5-8 seconds. The rest of the day it's fine. We're in London so for us it's our afternoon. Feels like a capacity issue on your side at peak US hours.

subject: Calendar view slow to load
body: The calendar view takes about 15 seconds to load a single month. List and board views are quick. We have maybe 400 tasks with due dates this month. Workspace ID ws_42817.
The desktop app uses 3GB of RAM after a few hours and my whole laptop slows down. I have to restart it twice a day. Is this a known memory leak?

subject: Sluggish after migration
body: Since you moved our workspace to the new infrastructure last weekend (we got the email), everything has been noticeably slower: opening tasks, switching projects, loading comments. Not broken, just slow enough that people are complaining. Workspace: thornfield-legal.ourapp.com

subject: Dashboard timeouts
body: Our executive dashboard has 12 widgets. Since last week, half of them time out and show "Could not load data" on the first load, then work after a refresh. It's embarrassing when I open it in front of our CEO. Is there a way to make it load reliably?
Opening the app on my phone takes like 20 seconds now, used to be 2. Web is fine. Also the app keeps asking me to rate it every time I open it which is annoying

subject: Very slow + wrong numbers?
body: Two issues with our reporting: first, the workload report takes over a minute to load, which it never used to. Second, when it does load, some people show 0 hours even though they've clearly logged time this week. Not sure if the two are related. Our workspace is fenwick-design.ourapp.com.

subject: Bug + feature idea
body: Found a bug: when you archive a project, its tasks still show up in "My Tasks" with no way to open them (clicking gives "Project not found"). Also, while I'm writing: it would be great if "My Tasks" could be grouped by project instead of only by due date.
Whenever someone on our team exports a board to PDF, the PDF is blank except for the header. It started around the 5th. CSV export still works fine. Workspace: marlowe-events.ourapp.com

subject: Slow and then outage?
body: The app was really slow for about an hour this morning and now it won't load at all for anyone here. Is this related to the maintenance you mentioned in last week's email? Our office has 45 people and we're completely stuck.

subject: Trial + a bug
body: We're on day 10 of our trial. We like it a lot, but we've hit a bug where the Gantt view doesn't show any tasks at all, just an empty timeline. Could you look into it? And since we lost a few days to this, could we get a few extra trial days? Workspace ID ws_81277.
Kanban cards show the wrong assignee avatar. It shows the person who created the task, not who it's assigned to. Opening the task shows the correct assignee. Confusing for everyone.

subject: Time zone bug in reminders
body: Reminders are firing at the wrong time for our team in India. A reminder set for 10:00 fires at 04:30 (which is 10:00 UTC). Our profile time zones are set correctly to Asia/Kolkata. This means people miss deadlines because the reminder comes in the middle of the night. It's been going on for about a week. Workspace ID ws_55771.

subject: Trial expired, need 3 days
body: Our trial expired yesterday. Our CFO approved the purchase this morning but the payment won't go through until our procurement system processes it, which takes 3 business days. Can you reactivate our workspace in the meantime? We have a client presentation on Wednesday that uses boards we built during the trial. Workspace: bluestone-advisory.ourapp.com
our trial says 2 days left but we only signed up yesterday?? is that a mistake

subject: Export stuck at 99%
body: I started an export of our workspace data two hours ago and it's been stuck at 99% ever since. I've tried cancelling and restarting, same thing. We need the export for an audit tomorrow.

subject: Mass outage - status?
body: Hi all, we're a 400-person company fully dependent on your platform for project delivery. Since 9:02 GMT, every request returns a gateway error. Your status page still says operational. Our engineering team has checked our side thoroughly. We need an ETA and ideally a named contact for the duration of this incident, as our executive team is asking for hourly updates. Account ID: acct_ent0017. Please treat as P1.
Page loads are slow but only for images and attachments. Thumbnails take 10+ seconds to appear, text loads instantly. Maybe a CDN issue? We're in Singapore.

subject: Bug in CSV import date format
body: When importing a CSV, dates in DD/MM/YYYY format are interpreted as MM/DD/YYYY, so 03/04/2025 becomes March 4th instead of 3rd April. There's no option to choose the format. Everything else about the import worked. We had to fix 300 tasks by hand.

subject: Slow + disconnects
body: The web app has become slow and every 15 minutes or so it shows "Connection lost, reconnecting..." for a few seconds. Our internet is stable (tested). It's happening to everyone in our office. Not blocking us but very disruptive.

Hi, the trial is great and we'd like to buy. But we also need to know: can the trial be extended by a week while we wait for the budget? And is there a discount if we buy 50 seats? Thanks a lot, Yuki (Tanabe Design Office)

subject: Notification badge stuck
body: The notification bell shows "9+" permanently even though I've read everything. Mark all as read does nothing. Been like this for a week.

subject: Task links broken after rename
body: When a project is renamed, all the links we've shared to its tasks (in emails, Slack, docs) stop working and go to a 404. We rename projects a lot at the end of each quarter. Is this expected? It'd be a real problem if so. Here's a broken one: ourapp.com/p/q3-planning/t/8812
The app is super slow today. Also, how do I set up a recurring task that repeats on the last Friday of every month?

subject: Outage last night?
body: Was there an outage around 2am UTC last night? Our overnight team in Manila said they couldn't access anything for about 40 minutes. Everything is fine now. Just want to know what happened so I can report it internally.

subject: Bug: subtask count wrong
body: The subtask counter on a task card shows 3/5 but there are actually 6 subtasks and 4 are done. Seems like it isn't counting subtasks added after the task was moved between projects. Not urgent.

Performance on the timeline view has gotten really bad. With about 300 tasks it takes 30+ seconds to render, and zooming in or out freezes the tab. Is there anything we can do while you look into it? We rely on the timeline for our weekly client updates. Org ID 51188.

subject: Can we extend while we migrate?
body: We're migrating from our current tool and the import is taking longer than we expected (lots of attachments). Our trial ends on Friday and we'll only be halfway through. Could we get an extra 7 days? We're planning to buy the Business plan for 30 people once we're done.

subject: Bug report: copy link
body: "Copy link" on a task copies a link to the project, not to the task. Tested in Chrome and Edge. It's been like this for a few days.

In the last hour nobody in our workspace can open attachments. Clicking any file gives "Access Denied". Files uploaded today and files from last year, same error. The rest of the app works. We're 25 people and we need these files for client work.

subject: Extend trial + questions about SSO
body: Could we get an additional week on our trial? We haven't been able to test SSO yet because our identity team is backlogged. On that note, does SSO work during the trial, or only after we subscribe to Business? We use Okta.

subject: Slow loading since new release
body: Since your new release on Tuesday, every page takes 4-6 seconds to load for our team. It was under a second before. I've attached... no, I can't attach. Anyway, we tested from home and office networks, same result. We're on the Business plan. acct_sl0w11
Clicking "Mark complete" on a subtask marks the parent task complete instead. Every time. Please fix, this is messing up our tracking.

subject: Sorting by priority wrong
body: When I sort tasks by priority, the order is Low, Medium, Urgent, High instead of Urgent, High, Medium, Low. It looks like it's sorting alphabetically. Minor but confusing.

subject: Service degraded?
body: Some pages load and some don't. Boards are fine, but opening any task gives "Something went wrong" about half the time. Colleagues see the same thing. Is there a partial outage?

Our weekly email digest is showing tasks from the wrong workspace. I got a digest listing tasks from a workspace I'm not a member of. That seems like a privacy problem? I'm not sure who else might be seeing my tasks.

subject: Report export slow
body: Exporting a report to Excel takes 5+ minutes for about 10,000 rows. Is there a faster way, like an API endpoint for bulk export? We do this weekly.

subject: Trial - SSO, and extension
body: Hey, we are 3 days from the end of our trial. We haven't been able to test the Salesforce integration because our Salesforce admin was on leave. Can we extend by one week? We're pretty sure we'll buy but want to test that first. Thanks, Arjun, workspace velocity-ops.ourapp.com
The board freezes for a few seconds every time someone else on the team makes a change. With 10 of us editing during planning, it's constantly freezing. Only started this week.

subject: Double notifications
body: Every notification (in-app and email) comes in twice since the weekend. Same content, a few seconds apart. It happens for all 15 of us. Workspace ID ws_20077.

subject: Error when saving template
body: Trying to save a project as a template gives "Error TPL-500: template could not be created". The project has about 80 tasks and some attachments. Smaller projects save as templates fine.
Everything times out. Can't load anything. Whole team. Please help.

subject: Trial reactivation for a demo
body: Our trial expired last month. We didn't buy at the time, but our new director wants to see the product before we decide. Could you reactivate our old trial workspace for a week so I can show her what we built? It's the one at nettlebed-farms.ourapp.com.

subject: App slow on older PCs
body: Several people on our team with older Windows 10 laptops say the app is almost unusable: 10-second page loads, typing lag. People with newer machines are fine. Is there a lighter mode or minimum requirements?
When I filter by a custom field and then sort by due date, the filter is removed. Doing it in the other order works. Low priority, just reporting it.

subject: Complete outage for us only?
body: Our workspace is completely inaccessible (error page "Workspace unavailable"), but I can log into my personal workspace fine. So it's something specific to our company workspace. We're 70 people and nobody can work. Did something happen to our account? Org ID 81244, workspace aspen-grove.ourapp.com

subject: Slow API + webhooks delayed
body: Our webhook deliveries are arriving 10-20 minutes late, and API calls are taking several seconds each. We use webhooks to trigger our warehouse picking, so delays mean orders ship late. Is there a known performance issue? Delivery ID example: evt_01JB2W8K9F.
Can you extend my trial? I've been sick most of the two weeks. Just need a few more days to try the reporting. My email's hana.kobayashi@me.com

subject: Emoji reactions broken
body: Clicking an emoji reaction on a comment gives a red error toast and the reaction doesn't stick. This is minor but people use reactions a lot to acknowledge things.

subject: Slow sync between devices
body: Changes I make on my laptop take several minutes to show up for my colleagues. It used to be almost instant. We work in the same office. Nothing is lost, it's just delayed.
App crashed for everyone in our workspace 20 min ago and hasn't come back. White screen with 'Application error'. Our whole business runs on this. Please hurry.
